evidence.words: This guarantee is not conditional on any demand first being made of the EPC Contractor.

statements.text: The words of Form 4-D items 1 to 3 are unchanged at ADD-03; ADD-03 Q15 only confirms them (annotation).

evidence.words: delay liquidated damages at the rate of one-twentieth of one per cent (0.05%) of the Estimated Project Cost for each day of delay

statements.text: At ADD-03 the delay liquidated damages rate in VOL-V 18.1 is 0.05% of the Estimated Project Cost for each day of delay (replacing SAR 180,000 per day).

evidence.words: Volume V Clause 18.4 is unchanged.

statements.text: With the 10% of Estimated Project Cost cap of VOL-V 18.4 (stated unchanged by ADD-03 4.1), the cap is reached after 200 days of delay (calculate: cap, 10% / 0.05% per day = 200 days). The 10% figure is read from VOL-V 18.4, which is not among the units quoted here.

evidence.words: as stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees

statements.text: ADD-03 2.1 makes the Estimated Project Cost the figure stated by the Bidder in Form 4-F, excluding financing costs, interest during construction and development fees.

evidence.words: Title: Financial Proposal Schedule | Envelope: B | Status: Mandatory

statements.text: Form 4-F is an Envelope B form.

evidence.words: shall be retained unopened by the Authority and returned to the Bidder after the Preferred Bidder Notification

statements.text: The Envelope B of a Proposal that does not proceed to commercial evaluation is retained unopened and returned after the Preferred Bidder Notification.

evidence.words: ‘twenty-five per cent (25%) of the Estimated Project Cost’ is substituted

statements.text: ADD-03 3.1 replaces SAR 800,000,000 in the VOL-I 8.4 financial capacity requirement by 25% of the Estimated Project Cost.

evidence.words: amends the definition of Estimated Project Cost, the financial capacity requirement in Volume I Clause 8.4 and the delay liquidated damages in Volume V Clause 18.1

statements.text: The financial capacity test of VOL-I 8.4 now depends on a figure that is only stated in Envelope B (Form 4-F); the pack does not say how or when the Authority applies it, nor which Estimated Project Cost applies to a Proposal whose Envelope B is never opened. Insufficient evidence to settle this.

evidence.words: Ref: G | Criterion: Energy efficiency and specific energy consumption | Marks: 20

statements.text: Table 1-1 (second revision) totals 120 marks and adds criterion G (Energy efficiency and specific energy consumption, 20 marks); criteria A to F are unchanged.

evidence.words: A Proposal whose technical score is less than seventy per cent (70%) of the total marks available in Table 1-1 shall not proceed to commercial evaluation.

statements.text: The technical threshold is 70% of the total marks in Table 1-1: 70% x 120 = 84 marks (calculate: threshold_of_total), against 70 out of 100 before ADD-03.

evidence.words: ما نسبته عشرة في المائة (١٠٪) أو أكثر من رأس مال العضو أو من حقوق التصويت فيه

statements.text: The Arabic Form 4-H (image, Appendix A) defines a beneficial owner by a holding of ten per cent (10%) or more.

evidence.words: twenty-five per cent (25%) or more of the capital of the member or of the voting rights in it

statements.text: The English Form 4-H text defines a beneficial owner by a holding of twenty-five per cent (25%) or more.

evidence.words: The Arabic text governs. The English translation at Appendix B is provided for convenience only.

statements.text: ADD-03 8.2 states that the Arabic text of Form 4-H governs and the English translation is for convenience only.

evidence.words: ما نسبته عشرة في المائة (١٠٪) أو أكثر

statements.text: Pending clarification, list every natural person holding 10% or more (the governing Arabic threshold); this also lists every 25% holder, so it satisfies both versions.

evidence.words: adds a Declaration of Beneficial Ownership (Form 4-H) which all Bidders may submit through the Portal within five Working Days after the Proposal Due Date
A member of the Bidder that is incorporated outside the Kingdom may instead submit its Form 4-H through the Portal not later than five (5) Working Days after the Proposal Due Date.

statements.text: The ADD-03 cover paragraph says all Bidders may submit Form 4-H through the Portal within five Working Days after the Proposal Due Date, while ADD-03 8.3 requires Form 4-H with Envelope A and allows the Portal route only to a member incorporated outside the Kingdom.

evidence.words: which all Bidders may submit through the Portal within five Working Days after the Proposal Due Date

statements.text: Plan to submit Form 4-H for every member with Envelope A (the operative clause); treat the Portal route as available only to members incorporated outside the Kingdom until the Authority clarifies.

evidence.words: issued within the thirty (30) days preceding the date for submission of Proposals

evidence.words: Form 4-H shall be completed in the Arabic language, signed and stamped by an authorised signatory of each member of the Bidder.

evidence.words: Bidders shall acknowledge receipt in Form 4-A.

statements.text: ADD-03 requires Bidders to acknowledge its receipt in Form 4-A; no consequence is stated.
